description: Canonical index of all SC4LE schemas used for metadata validation, sensing, and governed content generation.

sc4le-standard-v1.description: General-purpose schema for SC4LE standards, governance documents, and foundational artefacts.

sc4le-role-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE operating model roles including CDA, LDA, Board Advisor LDA, and architect roles.

sc4le-service-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE service definitions aligned to the service-definition-schema.json.

sc4le-brand-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE brand assets such as logo usage, tone of voice, and typography.

sc4le-diagram-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE diagrams including operating model, governance, and sensing visuals.

sc4le-template-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE templates including page templates, decision logs, and governance records.

sc4le-web-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE website pages aligned to page-template-schema.json.

sc4le-value-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE value propositions aligned to the value-proposition-schema.json.

sc4le-programme-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE programmes such as SCALE-UPS.

sc4le-maturity-v1.description: Schema for SC4LE maturity model components and diagnostics.
